title: Configure Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL connection
description: Install and configure Drizzle ORM in the server with a PostgreSQL connection using the pg driver. Set up the Drizzle client, schema directory, and drizzle-kit for migrations. Verify a test query can connect to the database.
acceptanceCriteria: drizzle-orm and pg packages are installed in server/
db.ts exports a Drizzle database client connected to PostgreSQL
drizzle.config.ts is configured for drizzle-kit migrations
Running 'npm run db:migrate' applies all pending migrations
A test query (SELECT 1) succeeds when server starts

steps.description: Install Drizzle ORM and PostgreSQL driver
steps.details: In server/: npm install drizzle-orm pg. npm install -D drizzle-kit @types/pg. These provide the ORM, the pg driver, and the CLI for migrations.

Create server/src/db/index.ts: import { drizzle } from 'drizzle-orm/node-postgres'; import { Pool } from 'pg'; import * as schema from './schema'; const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL }); export const db = drizzle(pool, { schema }); export { pool };
Create server/src/db/schema/index.ts as an empty barrel that will re-export all table definitions added in subsequent tasks. Start with: // Schema exports will be added here as tables are defined.

Create server/drizzle.config.ts: import type { Config } from 'drizzle-kit'; import * as dotenv from 'dotenv'; dotenv.config(); export default { schema: './src/db/schema/index.ts', out: './drizzle', driver: 'pg', dbCredentials: { connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL! }, verbose: true, strict: true } satisfies Config;

Add: 'db:generate': 'drizzle-kit generate:pg', 'db:migrate': 'drizzle-kit push:pg', 'db:studio': 'drizzle-kit studio'. The push command applies schema directly for development; generate+migrate for production.

steps.description: Add database connection verification on server startup
steps.details: In server/src/index.ts, before app.listen, add: pool.query('SELECT 1').then(() => console.log('[DB] Connected to PostgreSQL')).catch(err => { console.error('[DB] Connection failed:', err); process.exit(1); });
Start Docker Compose (npm run db:up from root), copy .env.example to server/.env and fill in values, then run 'npm run dev' in server/. Verify '[DB] Connected to PostgreSQL' appears in logs.

technicalNotes: Use Pool from pg (not Client) for connection pooling — important for concurrent requests
drizzle-kit push:pg is fine for development; use generate + migrate for production migrations
